target_customer: M&A lawyers, serial acquirers, asset managers and real estate diligence teams
problem: Due diligence means sorting thousands of files in data rooms; Tower organizes them, flags gaps and answers questions with citations.
product_category: AI legal and M&A due diligence platform

founders.name: Andy Zhang
founders.background_notes: The launch post says ML quant at a pension fund and founding engineer at NRN Agents; sources differ.

founders.name: Noah (surname not listed)
prior_employers: Dentons (M&A and tech lawyer, per launch post)

technical_complexity.rationale: Document ingestion, extraction and cited answering over messy data rooms is standard LLM engineering with hard accuracy requirements.

defensibility.rationale: Workflow lock-in and security certifications help, but legal AI vendors are numerous and well funded.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; sources list Kira and Luminance as incumbents but only from a weak aggregator, so unverified.

market_need_then: M&A diligence is document heavy and billed hourly by law firms; the company claims 1000+ use cases and AmLaw 50 firms as customers (self reported).

brand_strength.rationale: The name is generic and conflicts with Git Tower, other Tower software and a Berlin data startup also called Tower.

pivots.from: AI assistant for in-house legal counsel requests
pivots.why: Earlier positioning from a May 2024 Waterloo Q&A and Stanford index; timing and reason not stated.

outcome_analysis: Tower moved from an in-house legal request assistant to an M&A due diligence platform, with a lawyer cofounder and engineers from Waterloo. Only YC funding is known, and a crowded legal AI field with funded incumbents makes the path uncertain; the outcome is open.
notes: One aggregator lists $125K in one round; unverified, so no round. A different Tower (Berlin data engineering) raised $6.4M in 2026 and is unrelated. Competitor list came from a weak AI generated profile and is not dated near the batch, so left empty. Andy Zhang background differs between YC profile and launch post. Competition list empty: no sources dated near the batch were found.
